feature_contract.goal: Correct the full OutRun 2006 VR main/front-menu and vehicle-selection theater physical geometry without cropping authored right-edge car and menu content, while preserving per-eye menu presentation and legacy fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R23 LOCAL-fixed non-gameplay captured-menu optical aspect and full game-client validation; no gameplay HUD/F11/ESC, lens, game camera/FFB/SkyGlow, R26_SAFE, DX11, or frozen DXVK changes.
trace_stages: Original native game main-menu and vehicle-selection sprites render on captured desktop client, with letterbox configuration read from the actual game process.
R23 GetGameUv and native client rectangle capture the complete original menu, then menu-content-aspect computes an authored optical 4:3 physical plane without cropping UV pixels.
Common intersected OpenXR eye tangents project identical LOCAL-fixed clip geometry for both eyes, with captured-fragment and explicit native-aspect fallbacks preserved.
subcomponents: Separate the full-client source UV rectangle from its physical menu display aspect: keep all Ferrari/model/list pixels while correcting 21:9 and 16:9 optical width when original letterbox mode is configured.
Constrain correction to complete, finite, non-portrait source clients, maintain clipped-window fallback and reversible OUTRUN_VR_MENU_NATIVE_ASPECT=1, and guard 4:3/portrait/uncropped configurations.
Exercise positive and negative menu-aspect cases in the portable C++ menu smoke test, then validate x86 R84, x64 OpenXR host, package, Domain and Full Source on the final exact SHA.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original game menu and car selector to OpenXR LOCAL-fixed binocular projection
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Fully captured 21:9 and 16:9 configured game menus keep every native source pixel while projecting at preserved authored 4:3 physical proportions in both LOCAL-fixed OpenXR eyes.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original desktop/cropped game client and user selectable native menu plane
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Explicit 4:3 center crop, window/output-edge partial capture, native 4:3 or portrait resolution, invalid aspect and no-letterbox menus retain prior behavior; OUTRUN_VR_MENU_NATIVE_ASPECT=1 fully restores previous uncropped display proportions.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: GitHub Actions Windows game/host/full-chain/package and domain/source impact checks
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The validation-bearing commit passes existing DX9Ex Active x86 game/R84, x64 OpenXR host, package, R26_SAFE, Domain and applicable Full Source/HUD gates on one exact SHA; no HMD PASS without actual matching Quest3 test.

diagnosis.root_cause: R23 native LOCAL-fixed menu projected a complete uncropped 3440x1440 captured game client using its wide desktop aspect. The source menu's intentionally authored 4:3 visual proportions became optically ultrawide, whereas center-only texture crop discards user-observed car-selection/menu pixels outside that rectangle.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Issue #119 Quest3/VDXR A/B capture: default crop OFF shows wide/distorted header and car selection, crop ON cuts authored Ferrari and right-hand list. R23 source used PlanCapturedAspect without distinguishing optical authored aspect for complete uncropped game clients.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R23 constructs a single LOCAL-fixed menu clip from intersected left/right OpenXR FOV tangents and reuses it in both eyes, independent of gameplay stereo draw semantics.
source_trace: vrhost/src/main_r23.cpp R23RenderWorldLockedMenuProjection reads game configured letterbox, GetGameUv and actual GetClientRect and chooses center crop only under explicit override.
vrhost/src/runtime/menu_content_aspect.hpp PlanUncroppedAuthoredMenuAspect gates optical 4:3 display proportions on complete captured letterboxed game client and reversible native fallback.
vrhost/src/main_r23.cpp passes corrected sourceAspect only to PlanOpticallyCenteredClip for the shared LOCAL-fixed two-eye geometry, retaining every pixel of original captured UV.
vrhost/tests/menu_content_aspect_smoke.cpp checks ultrawide/16:9 source and negative crop/partial/4:3/portrait/NaN/explicit-native routes.
alternatives_rejected: Automatic 4:3 UV crop is rejected because user screenshot proves authored car-preview and menu choice pixels live outside nominal center 4:3.

Using native desktop 21:9 physical plane leaves the observed horizontally overlarge theater uncorrected; correction is limited to proven complete game client and original letterbox-mode configuration.
Changing gameplay stereoscopic R29-R33, F11, SkyGlow or game menu timings would not target this host LOCAL-menu optical source mismatch.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Source implementation commit abb3c45560cf00b57be7fe1b66f1e3998295635f modified actual C++ menu host and aspect helper, plus end-to-end menu aspect smoke positive and negative cases.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: menu_content_aspect_smoke.cpp rejects correction for no letterbox, partial/unreliable captured client, already cropped mode, native rollback, native 4:3 and portrait, NaN sampled aspect and infinite client aspect.
diagnosis.runtime_evidence: No actual Quest3 or VDXR optical/menu test was run; screen proportions, car selection legibility and runtime behavior are not asserted PASS.
diagnosis.next_hmd_experiment: On Quest3/VDXR inspect full original main menu and Ferrari car selection on one same-SHA R84 ZIP at 3440x1440 capture and compare native-aspect rollback, then inspect 4:3 native and partially visible desktop window during recenter and resize.

second_recorded_gate.cause: Old verify_vr_menu_letterbox_aspect.py requires pre-binding original R23GameMenuIsLetterboxed(c.hwnd_), false); call literal. New implementation binds equivalent config to gameConfiguredLetterbox once and consumes it for both crop and projection.
